channel.title: Prepared Foods Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Prepared Foods Magazine (preparedfoods.com)

item.title: Kidfresh Expands Frozen Kids’ Meals With Veggie-Forward Combos
item.description: The frozen combo meals deliver 14–20g of protein per serving while incorporating vegetables such as cauliflower, navy beans and sweet potatoes. The launch reflects continued demand for convenient children’s meals with improved nutrition and clean label ingredients.

item.title: Cold Case Innovation Heats Up
item.description: From GLP-1-friendly yogurts and collagen creamers to swicy cheeses and protein-packed pints, processors are blending function with full flavor. In 2026, the refrigerated and freezer cases are proving that cold categories can deliver hot trends.

item.title: King & Prince Seafood Names Steve Yung CEO
item.description: Yung will assume the role April 20, 2026, following Alexander’s retirement three days earlier. The company said the transition is designed to maintain operational continuity and support ongoing innovation and partnerships.

item.title: Jack Link’s Launches 3-Ingredient Meat Snacks
item.description: Jack Link’s is introducing a portfolio of meat snacks made with just three ingredients, starting with air-dried beef slices launching nationwide this spring. The company also plans to expand its better-for-you offerings with antibiotic-free poultry snacks and grass-fed, zero-sugar jerky.

item.title: Organigram Debuts SHRED Shotz
item.description: With SHRED Shotz, Organigram is introducing a compact format designed to help broaden the beverage category and bring new consumers into the segment.

item.title: Smokiez Partners with Global Cannabis Exchange for International Expansion
item.description: Smokiez Partners with Global Cannabis Exchange for International Expansion

item.title: Grön Brings Chocolate Pips to New York
item.description: Made for day and night, Pips were created as an effect-based collection for consumers seeking options for different moments of the day.

item.title: Rare Cannabinoid Company Debuts CBC Mood Gummies
item.description: The CBC gummies expand the company's broader Mood collection and respond to growing consumer interest in cannabinoids that support emotional balance.

item.title: Wynk Introduces 3 mg THC Lemonades
item.description: Designed for those who need less than the 10 mg THC found in the original lemonades, Wynk’s 3 mg option has no sugar and is 0 calories.

item.title: OGeez! Unveils Triple Infused Gummies
item.description: Unlike traditional gummies that blend everything together, OGeez! designed Triple Infused using a three-stage layering process, with each layer infused separately to preserve the qualities of each extract.
